issues.title: Run JoinDependentFilterRule before DistributivityRule
issues.hypothesis: q19 shape: WHERE (j AND a1 AND b1) OR (j AND a2 AND b2) OR (j AND a3 AND b3) with a* on table A, b* on table B, j the join equality. JoinDependentFilterRule (src/optimizer/rule/join_dependent_filter.cpp) is meant to derive (a1 OR a2 OR a3) AND (b1 OR b2 OR b3) and let filter pushdown push them to each scan, but it only fires when the ROOT expression is a CONJUNCTION_OR (Apply line 56-65, is_root only true on the top-level call in ExpressionRewriter::VisitExpression). DistributivityRule is registered earlier (optimizer.cpp:52 vs :69) and fires first, rewriting the root into AND(j, OR(...)); after that the OR is never root, so no derived filters. Evidence: EXPLAIN shows no filter on part scan; join builds 2M part rows and emits 2.14M rows (HASH_JOIN 0.87s, FILTER 0.39s, decompress PROJECTION 0.09s). Manually adding the derived filters to the SQL: join output drops to 2,672 rows, join 0.01s, filter 0.00s, total 0.783s -> 0.644s (~18%), same result 41150783.5184.
issues.plan: In src/optimizer/optimizer.cpp Optimizer::Optimizer rule registration, move `rewriter.rules.push_back(make_uniq<JoinDependentFilterRule>(rewriter));` (line 69) to before DistributivityRule (line 52). Then the root OR is seen first: rule returns AND(original OR, derived), ApplyRules reruns (non-root) so Distributivity still factors j out of the inner OR; on the next fixpoint iteration root is AND so JoinDependent returns nullptr (no loop). Verify with EXPLAIN that the part scan gets an OR filter and lineitem gets an l_quantity OR filter (and the common shipmode/shipinstruct still pushed). If reordering causes trouble (e.g. other rules interfering, plan regressions), fallback: extend JoinDependentFilterRule::Apply to accept a root CONJUNCTION_AND, run the derivation on each CONJUNCTION_OR child, and append only derived conjuncts not already Equals() to an existing AND child (to guarantee fixpoint termination). Run the optimizer sql tests (test/optimizer/*join_dependent* if present) for results.
issues.expected_gain: q19 ~15-20% (join/filter/decompress phases nearly vanish; scan remains)
issues.generality: Any join query whose WHERE is a disjunction of per-branch conjunctions that each repeat the join key equality plus single-table predicates (common hand-written/ORM 'OR of cases' filters, TPC-H Q19, TPC-DS q13/q48-like shapes). Derived filters are implied by the original (sound), original predicate kept. Possible slowdown: extra redundant filter evaluation when derived filters are unselective (small cost).
issues.risk: Low. Pure optimizer rule order; derived predicates are logically implied. Watch for volatile expressions (rule already skips) and for changed plan shapes in other tests.

issues.title: Evaluate optional IN filters on dictionary strings inside scan
issues.hypothesis: After the join fix, q19 is dominated by the lineitem TABLE_SCAN (4.15s cumulative) plus a separate FILTER for l_shipmode IN ('..','..') (0.36s) because the IN pushdown is marked 'optional' and re-evaluated above the scan on 15M rows. Applying it inside the scan on dictionary/FSST segments (comparing dictionary entries once) would drop the FILTER op and reduce rows emitted from 15M to 2.1M, cutting downstream decompression of other columns.
issues.plan: Investigate how optional filters are created (grep 'optional' in src/planner/filter / dynamic/optional_filter) and whether dictionary_compression/fsst Select supports ConjunctionOr/InFilter; profile first.
issues.generality: Scans with small IN lists on low-cardinality string columns.
issues.risk: Medium; storage filter code, needs careful NULL/selection handling.

output.memory:
# Memory

## Round 1 (gen 1) findings
- q19 is the only visible template (TPC-H Q19 shape: OR of 3 branches, each with join eq + part preds + lineitem preds). Baseline ~307ms hot.
- Root cause found: JoinDependentFilterRule (src/optimizer/rule/join_dependent_filter.cpp) only fires on ROOT OR; DistributivityRule (registered earlier in optimizer.cpp:52 vs JoinDependent :69) factors the join eq out first -> root becomes AND, derivation never happens. Part scan unfiltered, join builds 2M rows.
- ExpressionRewriter::ApplyRules: is_root=true only on top call from VisitExpression; after a rule rewrites, recursion uses is_root=false; fixpoint loop re-enters with is_root=true.
- Manual SQL test with derived filters: join out 2.14M->2,672 rows, total 0.783s->0.644s (~18%), same result. Dispatched reorder fix.
- After that fix, lineitem scan dominates (~4s cumulative across threads): l_shipinstruct eq filter pushed into scan, l_shipmode IN is 'optional' filter re-evaluated by a FILTER op (0.36s) over 15M rows. Next direction: scan-side string filters (backlog issue).
- dbe-tool sql cannot run shell loops/pipes; run single statements. Single-run timings noisy; compare with profile run back-to-back.
